answer.rationale: The incumbent has refused price movement despite an 18% spend-cut mandate, making renewal unlikely to meet the cost objective. Archived evidence suggests the low-cost vendor delivered sharp unit-cost reductions and quick onboarding, but the line has no volume buffer and the prior record does not establish delivery performance at current committed volumes. Verify both the low-cost vendor outcome and incumbent continuity record before committing; if switching proceeds, gate it with delivery-readiness controls rather than assuming prior onboarding results fully transfer.
